header: A better starting point for accessibility reviews
content:
Desiderio provides semantic markup, visible focus styles for interactive parts and alternative-text fields for images. Editors are still responsible for useful alternative texts, a logical heading order and clear content.

Automated template checks reject inline styles and fixed colours. Contrast tests cover every theme preset in light and dark mode. These checks catch regressions. Full WCAG 2.2 conformance still depends on your configuration, extensions, content and tests with real users and assistive technology.
